title: Scoring engine v0: pure fold over rubric universe, skipped = no scorecard entry
rationale: trellis-92f6 implements SPEC §3.4 in src/scoring/ as 4 pure I/O-free modules + index barrel. Key design calls: (1) MODULE SPLIT band.ts (band+clampLevel) / entry.ts (ScorecardEntry §6.2 + zod + disposition/perCriterionScore) / aggregate.ts (repo+app outcome→entry) / score.ts (scoreRun fold). (2) THE COVERAGE 'skipped' TERM: SPEC §3.4 coverage = counted/(counted+no-detector+skipped) has THREE denom terms but naKind has only TWO values — resolved by making scoreRun take the rubric universe (criterionIds: readonly string[]) + a partial scorecard Map; ids in the universe with NO entry = 'skipped' (penalize coverage). not-applicable EXCLUDED from coverage base, no-detector + skipped IN it. Entries for ids outside the universe are ignored (universe is authoritative). (3) BAND boundaries lower-inclusive: band(x)= !(x>=0.2)?1 : x<0.4?2 : x<0.6?3 : x<0.8?4 : 5 — so band(0.2)=2, band(0.8)=5; the !(x>=0.2) form folds NaN to floor. (4) EDGE: counted===0 → passRate 0; coverageBase===0 → coverage 0; both → level 1 (all-N/A or empty universe bands L1). (5) Level type REUSED from src/rubric/summary.ts (scoring depends on rubric, not vice-versa). (6) AGGREGATION: repo denom always 1 (pass→1/1,fail→0/1,N/A→null/1+naKind); app numerator=passing apps, denom=N, all-N/A collapses to no-detector if any app no-detector else not-applicable; aggregateAppScope throws on 0 apps (discovery guarantees >=1 per §8.2); rationale clip()'d to 500. Outcome type ('pass|fail|not-applicable|no-detector') is a minimal LOCAL contract pending DetectorResult (trellis-5963). (7) gate/weight reserved, NOT read (§3.3). 100% coverage on all 4 modules, check:all exits 0.
